metadata.case_name: THAPA CHHETRI SHANKAR v. HENG MING METAL TRADING LTD

plaintiff.occupation_before: labourer or a causal construction site worker

injuries.description: amputation over the tip of the left middle finger; degloving injury of the left middle finger at one-third level of the distal phalanx with bare bone exposed; re-amputation performed.
source: As a result of the accident, the Plaintiff suffered an injury to his left middle finger, the tip was nearly severed.
He first attended Pok Oi Hospital where he was diagnosed an amputation over the tip of the left middle finger.

He was transferred to Tuen Mun Hospital for further examination where it was revealed that a degloving injury of the left middle finger at one-third level of the distal phalanx with bare bone exposed.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

manifestations.description: residual stiffness in the left middle finger
difficulty in cutting and preparing food

treatments_received: Transferred to Tuen Mun Hospital for further examination
Sick leaves granted from the date of the accident until 26th March 2007

losses.description: Amputation over the tip of the left middle finger; degloving injury and re-amputation leading to impairment of the finger.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty in cutting and preparing food.
